evals.prompt: We sell invoicing software to freelancers in Germany. I have keys for Firecrawl, DataForSEO, Google Ads, Search Console and Meta, and no Apify token. Plan the competitor and keyword research with the stack-ads toolkit: which commands you would run, in which order, and what needs my OK first. Do not run anything.
evals.expected_output: An ordered plan with free sources first, toolkit commands for the Meta Ad Library, Search Console and keyword data, a cost statement before paid calls, and the output files
expectations: The answer states the cost of the paid calls or asks to agree a research budget before the first paid call
The answer includes a `python3 ads/tools/ads.py meta ad-library` command with a `--countries` value
The answer includes a keyword step that uses `dataforseo post` or `google keyword-ideas`
The answer uses Search Console (`gsc query`) as a seed source
The answer names the output files ads/research/competitors.md and ads/research/keywords.md
